title: Implant indications and alien dyes found on Eric Mitchell

tellings.quote: but yeah I saw some indications of implants and and Eric and uh we found some dies on them recently.

plain: A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies what he says are alien implants in human bodies, says he found signs of implants in a man named Eric Mitchell. He adds that he and Mitchell recently found what he calls dyes on them, which he takes as more evidence that something foreign was placed in the body. Colbern tells it as his own work: "I saw some indications of implants."
